criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 3, 5 and 9 pass the feed test and 7 and 8 are dark around one lamp. 6 pale primitive boxes on the horizon with no pool or contact, about a tenth of the frame; 4 an untextured plank by low-poly clods; 2 a ribbon on a noise texture with a flat black channel. 7's chairs appear to face the camera.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One staged dark world, one accent meaning, the sign bookend and the 5 to 6 line both work, no value strobe, the cut at 7 lands. 3's blocks sit outside the line motif and 2's aerial reads in another register.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the quote matches c21. The de-annexation and the $220M deal rest only on the Tribune, and slide 3's 'a payment' is firmer than c15's 'agreed to give up to'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who decides, where, the decision, the deadline and the action are all delivered. The abatement's size and term are not stated, nor that the notice omits them; Chapter 380 is unglossed.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 5 turns, 9 lands. 4 jumps back, 8 delays the call to action, 3's ratio explains itself.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain local lines and honest balance on 8. Several fact-checker lines: 3's last sentence, 5's source dating, 6's 'Drawn to illustrate.', 7's code-section jargon.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat, but no. 62's abatement with its own power, stakes and a parcel to area, no. 69's stakes as a day count, no. 61's city limit sign and dais close and no. 63's dais all recur in lastLight.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild slide 6 so the plant fills a third of the frame in its own pool, and slide 4 as a grained pine lath with a cut point and tied flagging cropped tight on the foot and the hole.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: pale primitive boxes about a tenth of the frame, no pool or contact
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: about 120 m at eye 1.6 m, fov 18, side-lit with the key, contact under the skids, the line ending at its fence

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: untextured slab by low-poly clods, empty crust above
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: pine grain, sharpened point, wet clay foot, tied flagging, eye 0.5 m so the foot and hole fill the lower two thirds

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: ribbon on a noise texture, flat black channel, nothing of known size
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: riprap and water with the seam reflected, the near corner and shoulder in a pool, a tractor-trailer for scale

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: the chairs appear to face the camera
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: rotate the rows 180 degrees so the backs face the camera
